title: Memory Platform AI quickstart recipe
description: A reviewable model setup recipe. API keys and other secrets are deliberately forbidden and must be supplied through stdin. Field-level validation is implemented and enforced by model_gateway.quickstart.QuickstartRecipe; this schema mirrors it for external tooling, and the model wins whenever the two drift.

preset.description: Optional maintained channel preset. Custom channels should provide channel and base_url instead.

channel.description: Short name of the channel/operator that owns the API account.

base_url.description: Official OpenAI-compatible API base URL for this channel. Remote hosts must use HTTPS; plain HTTP is accepted only for loopback addresses, matching model_gateway.http_safety.normalize_base_url.

chat_model.description: Exact upstream chat model ID shown by the channel.

replace_existing_routes.description: Must be explicitly true before quickstart may replace existing memory/knowledge text routes.

space.description: Optional expert override. Omit it to derive an immutable ID from channel origin, exact model and dimensions.
